title: Willis S NDE 427
content: Started with intense pain, worst of my life. The pain was suddenly gone. I found myself in a dark void. No light. Slowly in the center of the void, I became aware of a change in color. The darkness had a pinpoint of grey. The grey slowly became white. This white spot began to grow. It was as if this white area was 3D. It was rising out of the void coming directly towards me. I saw it as either a volcano, or a pimple, no other way to put it. It was not a tunnel. The white area continued to rise toward me. I got the impression that the white area was swelling from internal pressure. As it came closer, I felt that I could almost touch it. The most important thing was the feeling that the internal pressure was reaching a bursting point. Somehow, I knew that if the white area burst all of the void would be replaced with an intense, warm, bright light. I also knew that if it burst, I was gone. I did my best to will it not to burst. I was not ready for that. Suddenly it was all gone, I was back in the catheterization lab and they were working on me, but the pain was gone.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Dark void; explicitly stated it was not a tunnel.

environment.environment_other_detail: Dark void with a pinpoint of grey that slowly became white; white area appeared 3D, 'rising out of the void' toward him like 'either a volcano, or a pimple.'

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He was 'not ready' and tried to will the white area not to burst because he believed if it burst, 'I was gone.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred in a catheterization lab; began with intense pain that suddenly stopped.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transitional void with growing 3D white area; no tunnel; return to catheterization lab.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Pain cessation → dark void → growing white 3D area (not tunnel) → attempted to prevent 'bursting' → sudden return to body/lab.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A 3D white area rising out of a dark void like 'either a volcano, or a pimple' that seemed to be swelling with internal pressure and might 'burst' to replace the void with intense warm bright light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I found myself in a dark void. No light." "It was not a tunnel." "Somehow, I knew that if the white area burst all of the void would be replaced with an intense, warm, bright light." "I also knew that if it burst, I was gone."
